get.description: Returns 200 while the process is up. It does not probe the database.

post.description: Creates a user account, baseline avatar configuration, and the initial organizational structure atomically.

201.description: Account and organizational structure created successfully.

400.description: Validation failed or missing required fields (e.g. invalid email, short password).

409.description: A user with this normalized email address already exists.

post.summary: Register account and select organizational path

post.description: Opens a session and returns a short-lived access token (JWT) plus an opaque refresh token. Send the access token in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential.

400.description: Validation failed (malformed email or missing password).

401.description: Invalid credentials. The response is identical for an unknown email and a wrong password.

post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token for the same session. The presented refresh token becomes invalid; presenting an already rotated token revokes the whole session, except within a short reuse window after its rotation (REFRESH_REUSE_GRACE, default 30s) where a new pair is issued for the same session. The session keeps its original expiry.

401.description: Unknown, already rotated, or expired refresh token, or a revoked or expired session. The response is the same generic error in every case.

post.description: Revokes the session of the Bearer access token. Afterwards that access token and the session's refresh tokens are rejected with 401.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

post.summary: Log out and revoke the current session

post.description: Always answers 202 with the same body, whether or not the email belongs to an account, so it cannot be used to discover registered emails. For a registered email a link (`<PASSWORD_RESET_URL_BASE>?token=<token>`) is emailed asynchronously; it is single-use and expires after PASSWORD_RESET_TTL (default 1h). Public endpoint.

202.description: Request accepted. Identical for registered and unregistered emails.

post.description: Spends the token from the emailed link: sets the new password and revokes every session of the account, so previous access and refresh tokens stop working. The token works once. Public endpoint.

204.description: Password changed and previous sessions revoked.

400.description: Validation failed (missing token, password outside the policy), or the token is unknown, already used or expired (BAD_REQUEST, the same generic error in every case).

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token

get.description: The global SessionAuthGuard verifies the session once; identity comes from CurrentUser. Missing, empty or unsupported stored appearance returns base defaults without changing stored appearance.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or revoked session.

get.summary: Read own profile and base avatar

patch.description: Uses the global SessionAuthGuard identity. Changes only displayName; unsupported stored appearance returns base defaults and a privacy-safe warning without repairing stored appearance.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED with per-field details; unknown fields rejected.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or revoked session.

patch.description: Uses the global SessionAuthGuard identity with one session verification. All five fields required, not a partial merge. Replaces stored base-only appearance, including unsupported legacy values. Body, hair and ordinary tops are free. Accessories and uniforms are not supported.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED with per-field details; unknown fields, incompatible choices and non-palette colors rejected.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or revoked session.

post.description: Atomically creates a persistent classroom together with its default classroom pet, initial desk layout, and school teacher membership when applicable. Allowed for independent teachers and school staff (Owner, Admin, Teacher).

201.description: Classroom, pet, and initial desks created atomically.

400.description: Validation failed (missing or invalid fields), or schoolId is missing for a caller who belongs to several schools.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

403.description: Caller is a student or parent related to the target school and is not allowed to create classrooms.

404.description: Specified school does not exist or the caller has no relation to it (indistinguishable by design).

get.description: Returns a paginated list (page, pageSize, sort=createdAt|name, default -createdAt) of classrooms accessible to the authenticated user (as School Owner/Admin, Teacher, enrolled Student, or active linked Parent when adultMode is false).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to order by; prefix with "-" for descending. Allowed fields and the default order are listed per endpoint.

400.description: Invalid pagination or sort parameters (page, pageSize, sort).

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

post.description: Redeems a valid classroom join code to atomically enroll the authenticated student and assign an available desk. Protected by sliding-window rate limiting against brute force attempts. Dynamic desk auto-expansion ensures desk allocation even if default desks are fully occupied.

201.description: Successfully joined the classroom with desk allocated.

400.description: Malformed code or join code is no longer active / expired.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

404.description: Join code does not exist or classroom was deleted.

409.description: Join code has reached maximum uses or concurrent join conflict occurred.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: too many invalid join code attempts.

post.summary: Join a classroom with access code

get.description: Returns the persistent state of a virtual classroom, its pet, desk count, and the server-derived role and capabilities for the authenticated caller.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

404.description: Classroom does not exist or caller has no relationship with it.

get.summary: Get classroom details and caller capabilities

patch.description: Updates classroom name, subject, adultMode, or live control flags (chatMuted, collaborationLocked, gamesDisabled). Restricted to staff of the classroom (School Owner/Admin or the classroom Teacher).

400.description: Validation failed: invalid or unknown fields, invisible or control characters in name or subject, or an empty body (at least one field is required).

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

403.description: Caller is a member (student or parent) with insufficient role.

404.description: Classroom does not exist or caller has no relationship with it.

patch.summary: Update classroom configuration and control flags

post.description: Issues a single-use email invitation for the specified classroom and schedules asynchronous email delivery via the transactional outbox. Restricted to teaching staff (School Owner/Admin or the classroom Teacher). Completely preserves non-disclosure (never reveals whether the email exists).

201.description: Email invitation created, raw secret token returned once, and outbox event scheduled.

400.description: Validation failed on email or role.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

403.description: Caller is a student or parent without invite_members capability.

404.description: Classroom does not exist or caller has no relationship with it.

post.summary: Issue an email invitation to join a classroom

get.description: Returns a paginated list of email invitations for the classroom. Restricted to classroom staff.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to order by; prefix with "-" for descending. Allowed fields and the default order are listed per endpoint.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter invitations by status (default is PENDING)

400.description: Invalid pagination or status filter parameters.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

403.description: Caller is a student or parent without invite_members capability.

404.description: Classroom does not exist or caller has no relationship with it.

get.summary: List email invitations for a classroom

delete.description: Marks an active email invitation as REVOKED so it can no longer be accepted. Restricted to classroom staff.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

404.description: Classroom or invitation does not exist.

post.description: Generates a new shareable join code for the classroom. If an active join code already exists, marks the previous code as REVOKED. The raw join code is returned ONCE in this response; only its SHA-256 hash is persisted. Restricted to classroom staff.

201.description: New join code created. Raw code is exposed only in this response.

400.description: Invalid parameters for maxUses or expiresInSeconds.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

404.description: Classroom does not exist or caller has no relationship with it.

post.summary: Generate or regenerate classroom join code

delete.description: Revokes the current active join code for this classroom, preventing any further student enrolments using it. Restricted to classroom staff.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

404.description: Classroom not found or no active join code exists.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of classrooms accessible to the authenticated user (as School Owner/Admin, Teacher, enrolled Student, or active linked Parent when adultMode is false) with derived role and capabilities.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to order by; prefix with "-" for descending. Allowed fields and the default order are listed per endpoint.

400.description: Invalid pagination or sort parameters (page, pageSize, sort).

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

get.summary: List classrooms accessible to the authenticated user

post.description: Atomically binds the authenticated user account to the classroom specified in the email invitation and assigns an available desk. Idempotent: re-accepting by an already enrolled student succeeds and returns the existing desk without error.

200.description: Classroom membership established and desk assigned.

400.description: Invitation token is malformed, expired, or already used.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token.

404.description: Invitation token does not exist or classroom was deleted.

post.summary: Accept an email invitation to join a classroom

info.title: Aula Virtual API
info.description: REST API of Aula Virtual. Every error uses the shared ErrorEnvelope schema; clients branch on error.code.

email.description: User email address, normalized to lowercase and trimmed

password.description: User password (between 8 characters and 72 UTF-8 bytes)

displayName.description: Display name for the user profile

schoolName.description: School name (required when path is SCHOOL)

slug.description: Unique slug generated for the school

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the school

school.description: Created school details if path is SCHOOL

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable code. Clients branch on this, never on the message.

field.description: Dotted path of the invalid field.

example: city must be longer than or equal to 3 characters

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Clients branch on this, never on the message.

correlationId.description: Echoes the x-request-id header; quote it when reporting a problem.

email.description: Account email address, normalized to lowercase and trimmed

password.description: Account password (at most 72 UTF-8 bytes, the bcrypt input limit)

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT (HS256). Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token. Stored server-side only as a SHA-256 digest; keep it secret.
The current opaque refresh token. It is single-use: the response carries its replacement.

email.description: Email of the account to reset, normalized to lowercase and trimmed

message.example: If the email belongs to an account, a reset link has been sent.
message.description: Constant message; it never reveals whether the email is registered.

token.description: The opaque token from the emailed link (`?token=`). It works once.

newPassword.description: The new password, under the same policy as registration

topId.description: male: hoodie/tank; female: hoodie/tank/tshirt. Uniforms excluded.

displayName.description: 1–100 characters after surrounding-space trimming. C0/C1 controls and Unicode line/paragraph separators are rejected before trimming; requires a character other than whitespace, default-ignorables, combining marks or braille blank. Unicode names, punctuation and joiners within visible names are preserved.

subject.description: Optional subject or course description for the classroom

schoolId.description: Optional target school UUID when the actor belongs to a school; omitted for independent teachers or resolved automatically from active school membership

id.description: Unique identifier of the classroom pet (UUID)

name.description: Display name of the classroom pet

species.description: Species identifier of the classroom pet

level.description: Current level of the classroom pet

experience.description: Accumulated experience points of the classroom pet
